Hi Elena / BrightPath team,

Quick weekly checkpoint on our MAP and the remaining items for finance approval. Attached: MAP_v3.xlsx (action tracker) and a short pricing summary.

Where we are:
- Baseline commit: 120M tokens/month (Q1 ramp) with burst to 200M for initial rollout.
- Proposed discount: 28% on list unit for first 12 months with a $150k commit credit spread across first invoice.
- Finance ask outstanding: sign-off on credit timing (upfront vs. invoice offset) and final PO line items.

Immediate asks from BrightPath:
1) Confirmation on whether the credit can be delivered as a 30-day invoice offset (preferred by their procurement).
2) Final billing entity and PO recipient.

Internal owners:
- Karthik: approve discount stack and escalate if we need leadership approval (>30% comp).
- Neha: capture commit sizing change and confirm revenue recognition cadence with Finance.
- Marissa: prepare a short executive note if we need a one-time concession.

Next internal milestone: finance sign-off by EOD Thursday to allow DocuSign routing Friday.

Elena — can you confirm by EOD Wednesday whether procurement can accept an invoice-offset credit model? If not, what alternate timing do you need?

Thanks,
Soojin

Thanks Soojin — quick response from our side.

Procurement prefers an invoice-offset structure; we can accept a 30-day offset against the first two invoices, provided the credit and PO line items are explicit. Our finance team has one constraint: credits cannot reduce the first invoice below $25k net due to internal minimums.

A couple of asks from BrightPath:
- Can the $150k credit be split 60/40 between invoice 1 and invoice 2?
- We need the final invoice recipient to be BrightPath Analytics, Inc. (EIN 12-3456789).

I'll follow up with a formal PO and the procurement contact for DocuSign routing by Thursday.

— Elena
Elena Vega
Head of Product, BrightPath Analytics

Soojin / Karthik —

Finance notes: invoice-offset is acceptable if we record the credit as a contra-revenue line and the PO references the credit schedule. Two items to confirm before we sign off:
1) Split of credit: 60/40 is fine, but we need BrightPath to acknowledge in the PO that invoice 1 will show a $90k credit and invoice 2 a $60k credit.
2) Minimum invoice floor: we can honor the $25k floor; however, final ARR & revenue recognition depend on the commit being firm in the contract (we'll need a signed DocuSign within 30 days of the first invoice).

If BrightPath signs to the above, Finance can approve routing to DocuSign by Friday. If Elena confirms the invoice-offset and the split this afternoon, I'll draft the internal finance memo and the modified term sheet.
